tests.name: the process alarms in the plant alarm log (tablets 1218) > [DI-49] a press alarm reading enters the batch's alarm log bound to the batch, the step and the unit, blocks the step signature, and its G-06 acknowledgment is the log's

the status displays (PR-22, PR-35) > [PR-22] the status display matches the system state after each transition
the status displays (PR-22, PR-35) > [PR-35] the station display shows the product and batch

area authorisation in the qualification matrix (PR-15) > [PR-15] area authorisations are recorded in the qualification matrix by the training coordinator, never for oneself, and withdrawn with a reason
alarms routes (DI-49) > [DI-49] the alarm list and the alarm show a room alarm with its limit, source time and no acknowledgment
alarms routes (DI-49) > [DI-49][INV-40] a GMP-critical alarm is acknowledged from a kiosk only with a fresh tap and a comment, once; QA without ALARM.ACKNOWLEDGE cannot
alarms routes (DI-49) > [DI-32] the series tags list every released process tag and the EMS room tags
area authorisation at the step (PR-15) > [PR-15] a user without area authorisation cannot sign a step in the controlled area
alarms and equipment-data contracts and the integration SDK > [meta] the contract enums equal the SDK equipment-data enums
